title: Pull the Pin: Sequential Penalties and 'Fake Difficulty'
subtitle: Deconstructing the penalty mechanics and fake difficulty design in pull-the-pin puzzles. The article analyzes how sequence errors trigger immediate restarts, leveraging low forgiveness to create a 'seemingly hard, actually fake' challenge experience. It reveals the underlying logic of building levels via rule-based constraints rather than complex operations, offering high-value design references for puzzle games.
